summary: Backend (pytest, 11/11 passed) and frontend UI (Playwright) end-to-end tested against the live preview URL. All major flows pass: dashboard, template instantiation, wizard create (steps 0-2 + auto-generate on review + save), workspace tabs (overview/workflow/data/run/results/activity/improve/deploy), owner run with sample data producing 5 workflow steps + report + checklist, improve/feedback -> v2 with 'improve-change' panel, publish gating (disabled before test_run and after feedback until re-tested), publish producing public URL, public page runs without owner tabs, unpublish shows 'isn't available' message, theme toggle switches light<->dark.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in favor of lifespan handlers. Not blocking but should migrate.

RunView: when 'Use sample dataset' is on, the 'situation' textarea is still required (frontend validation + backend check_inputs). This is fine but worth documenting in UI help text so users understand both the sample and a situation note are needed for a successful test_run (gating publish).

Backend: run endpoint uses path param 'ref' which is agent_id in owner mode and slug in public mode -- clear but a shared route may surprise maintainers; consider splitting into /agents/{id}/run and /public/agents/{slug}/run.

Dashboard 'agents-empty' only renders when agent list is empty; previous test runs leave agents behind. Consider a cleanup/demo reset at app bootstrap for e2e consistency (there IS a reset-demo UI control, so acceptable).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created a few TEST_ agents and a published waterlogging sample (then unpublished).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_domainforge.py covers templates, instantiate, generate, CRUD, owner run (needs 'situation' input filled to pass test_passed gate), prepublish/publish/public GET/public run/unpublish/403-after-unpublish, and publish-blocked-without-test-run. For UI testing the critical gotcha: owner RunView requires the 'situation' required field to be filled even when 'Use sample dataset' is on, otherwise test_passed stays false and the Publish button stays disabled.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. One test author pitfall worth noting: owner run with ONLY use_sample=true (no inputs.situation) produces check_inputs warning -> test_passed remains false and prepublish 'test_run' item stays red. Fix in test (not product): include {"situation": "..."} in run payload.
